statements.impact_statement: No package of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is built. go list -deps ./... names four packages of golang.org/x/crypto: chacha20, chacha20poly1305, internal/alias and internal/poly1305. They come in through the voice package of the Discord library. Checked again on 2026-10-17 with golang.org/x/crypto v0.58.0 and disgo v0.19.6: the same four packages, no openpgp package; the advisory names no fixed version.
